text: This patch renames the Thunderbird default key from devtools.webconsole.groupWarningMessages to devtools.webconsole.groupSimilarMessages while preserving true. Current accepted source retains the new declaration and comment about grouping/repeating similar messages. The change supplies no saved-user-value migration or consumer/UI implementation, so those outcomes need separate evidence. This is the exact default namespace, not a global naming rule. No console or preference test ran.
title: Thunderbird console defaults use groupSimilarMessages instead of groupWarningMessages
